en-US.description: Offline tool that extracts vocals and instrumental tracks from audio files like MP3 and WAV in batches.
en-US.longDescription:
Vovsoft Vocal and Instrumental Splitter is a dedicated desktop utility designed to effortlessly extract human vocals and background music from your audio tracks. Whether you are creating karaoke backing tracks, gathering samples for a remix, or analyzing instrumentation, this tool isolates the core audio components and saves them as distinct, ready-to-use files.

Compatible with a wide range of standard and high-fidelity audio files, including WAV, MP3, M4A, WMA, OGG, and FLAC.

Key Features:
* Dual File Output: Automatically creates two separate audio files for every track processed—one containing the isolated human vocals and the other containing the instrumental backing track.
* Batch Processing: The interface allows you to add individual files or entire folders, making it easy to queue and process multiple tracks in a single session.
* Customizable Output: Select your desired output audio type from a convenient dropdown menu and specify whether to save the split tracks in the original source folder or a custom directory.
* Complete Offline Privacy: Powered by the ONNX runtime, all audio source separation happens entirely on your local machine. No cloud servers, internet connection, or data uploads are required, guaranteeing your files remain private.
* Zero Dependencies: The software runs natively as a standalone application. There is no need to install complex Python environments or third-party frameworks.

Because neural network-based audio separation is highly resource-intensive, this software utilizes multi-threaded CPU operations and system RAM. While it is optimized for modern hardware, users running older computers may experience longer processing times during extraction.
en-US.name: Vovsoft Vocal and Instrumental Splitter
